mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates and increased risk appetite in a low-rate environment.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% but 20d returns negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises >0.5pp in 3 months but 5d returns positive in >60% of cases, or t-test p-value >0.05 vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as corporate revenue growth stalls.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline but 20d returns positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY >2.5%), a federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25pp in 3 months triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as monetary tightening pressures equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY change >2.5% and FEDFUNDS increases >0.25pp in 3 months
failure_condition: Condition met but 60d returns positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as stronger economic activity boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth >2.0% but 60d returns negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of industrial production below 100 (index) signal manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as output contraction weighs on earnings.
failure_condition: INDPRO <100 for 2 months but 20d returns positive in >60% of cases, or t-test p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS >100k) during labor market expansion predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as rising consumer spending supports corporate revenue.
failure_condition: PAYEMS >100k but 5d returns negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and employment growth indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as economic momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: HOUST and PAYEMS both increase but 20d returns negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.
